run_single_site_random_walk_inference: run SingleSiteRandomWalk MCMC inference on a probabilistic model with queries and observations
test_random_walk_full_support: test SingleSiteRandomWalk inference on a model with full real number line support
test_random_walk_half_support: test SingleSiteRandomWalk inference on a model with non-negative half-line support
test_random_walk_interval_support: test SingleSiteRandomWalk inference on a model with bounded interval support constraints
test_adaptive_random_walk: test SingleSiteRandomWalk with adaptive step sizing using num_adaptive_samples parameter
